dct_title_s: Flood Impact Assessment in North Taungoo, Bago State, Myanmar as of 02 October 2024
dct_description_sm: **UNOSAT code: FL20240912MMR** This map illustrates satellite detected floods using WorldView-3 images acquired on 02 October 2024. Within the analysed area of about 23 km², a total of about 21 km² of land appears to be affected by flood waters with about 18 km² of cropland inundated. UNITAR-UNOSAT identified approximately 2,240 affected buildings, representing 94% of the buildings as well as 35 km of affected roads, covering 88% of the roads in the analysed area. This is a preliminary analysis and has not yet been validated in the field. Please send ground feedback to the United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT).
